knowledge.q: What songs can you hear in the Extended Look?
knowledge.text: Fourteen licensed songs, from Birdman and Lil Wayne to Phil Collins, by way of Def Leppard, Depeche Mode and Cliff Richard. The press listed them with their timestamps; Rockstar hasn’t published the list.

knowledge.q: What is “Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album”?
knowledge.text: The game’s official album, announced by Rockstar and Atlantic Records on September 17, 2026: 34 original tracks, coming out on November 19, 2026 with the game. Six tracks are already out, including those by Travis Scott, Yung Lean and Keith Richards.

knowledge.q: Are the station names going around confirmed?
knowledge.text: No. These names come from the radio menu in stolen videos from August 2026, not from a Rockstar presentation. The site doesn’t use them and is waiting for the official station announcement.
